definitions.gloss: water resistance; water-resistant quality; waterproof property
definitions.explanation: The ability of a material or product to resist the penetration or effects of water. Used when describing the properties of fabrics, coatings, electronics, and other products.

examples.japanese: この{時計|とけい}は{耐水性|たいすいせい}がある。
{耐水性|たいすいせい}の{高|たか}い{素材|そざい}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: It uses a highly water-resistant material.

examples.japanese: この{塗料|とりょう}は{耐水性|たいすいせい}に{優|すぐ}れているので、{屋外|おくがい}でも{長|なが}く{使|つか}えます。
examples.english: This paint has excellent water resistance, so it can be used outdoors for a long time.

notes:
A compound of {耐水|たいすい} (water-resistant) and {性|せい} (property, quality). The {耐|たい}～{性|せい} pattern is highly productive in Japanese for expressing resistance or durability: {耐熱性|たいねつせい} (heat resistance), {耐久性|たいきゅうせい} (durability), {耐震性|たいしんせい} (earthquake resistance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐水性|たいすいせい}がある: to have water resistance
- {耐水性|たいすいせい}に{優|すぐ}れる: to excel in water resistance
- {耐水性|たいすいせい}の{高|たか}い: highly water-resistant
- {耐水性|たいすいせい}{試験|しけん}: water resistance test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {防水|ぼうすい}: waterproof — implies complete water blocking, stronger than {耐水性|たいすいせい}
- {撥水|はっすい}: water-repellent — water beads and rolls off the surface
- {耐久性|たいきゅうせい}: durability — general resistance to wear, broader than just water
